Resource limits
One sequential decoder at a time. A worker is stopped above 2.5 GiB RSS or after 180 s per method (480 s for the four full-budget distance-31 references).
Timing
Median wall time per shot over full-sized, warmed inference calls on unpacked boolean detector input. Standard batch 128; fixed 16-shot pilots use batch 16. File IO, sampling, evaluating predictions and setup excluded. Required input packing included.
Calibration
Learned routing loads a matching archived Z policy at distances 5/7 and otherwise trains on 4096 independent records (1024 at d31). Count and space-time routing train on the same independent calibration prefix at cap 50%. Single-thread belief and search; ordinary weighted matching uses temporal scale 0.75 and boundary scale 1.
